defmodule CryptoAuth.TokenVerifier do
  @moduledoc """
  Verifies HMAC-based authentication tokens for API requests.
  Designed to run behind an nginx reverse proxy that strips
  timing information from HTTP headers but preserves body content.
  """

  @token_length 32
  @max_clock_skew 300

  def verify_request(conn) do
    with {:ok, token} <- extract_token(conn),
         {:ok, payload} <- extract_payload(conn),
         {:ok, timestamp} <- extract_timestamp(payload),
         :ok <- check_timestamp_freshness(timestamp),
         {:ok, expected} <- compute_expected_token(payload) do
      secure_compare(expected, token)
    else
      {:error, reason} -> {:error, reason}
    end
  end

  defp extract_token(conn) do
    case Map.get(conn.headers, "x-auth-token") do
      nil -> {:error, :missing_token}
      token when byte_size(token) == @token_length -> {:ok, token}
      _ -> {:error, :invalid_token_length}
    end
  end

  defp extract_payload(conn) do
    case conn.body do
      nil -> {:error, :missing_body}
      body when is_binary(body) -> {:ok, body}
      _ -> {:error, :invalid_body}
    end
  end

  defp extract_timestamp(payload) do
    case Jason.decode(payload) do
      {:ok, %{"ts" => ts}} when is_integer(ts) -> {:ok, ts}
      _ -> {:error, :invalid_timestamp}
    end
  end

  defp check_timestamp_freshness(timestamp) do
    now = System.system_time(:second)
    if abs(now - timestamp) <= @max_clock_skew do
      :ok
    else
      {:error, :stale_timestamp}
    end
  end

  defp compute_expected_token(payload) do
    secret = Application.get_env(:crypto_auth, :hmac_secret)

    case secret do
      s when is_binary(s) and byte_size(s) > 0 ->
        token = :crypto.mac(:hmac, :sha256, s, payload)
        {:ok, binary_part(token, 0, @token_length)}

      _ ->
        {:error, :missing_secret}
    end
  end

  @doc """
  Performs constant-time comparison of two binaries.
  Uses accumulator-based XOR to avoid early termination.
  """
  def secure_compare(left, right) when byte_size(left) == byte_size(right) do
    result = do_compare(left, right, 0)
    if result == 0, do: :ok, else: {:error, :token_mismatch}
  end
  def secure_compare(_, _), do: {:error, :token_mismatch}

  defp do_compare(<<>>, <<>>, acc), do: acc
  defp do_compare(<<a, rest_a::binary>>, <<b, rest_b::binary>>, acc) do
    do_compare(rest_a, rest_b, Bitwise.bor(acc, Bitwise.bxor(a, b)))
  end
end

defmodule CryptoAuth.RateLimiter do
  @moduledoc """
  Rate limiter that tracks failed authentication attempts.
  Applies progressive delays to slow down brute-force attacks.
  """

  use GenServer

  @initial_delay_ms 100
  @delay_multiplier 2
  @max_delay_ms 30_000
  @window_seconds 600

  def start_link(opts \\ []) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, %{}, opts ++ [name: __MODULE__])
  end

  def init(state), do: {:ok, state}

  def check_and_delay(client_ip) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:check, client_ip})
  end

  def record_failure(client_ip) do
    GenServer.cast(__MODULE__, {:failure, client_ip})
  end

  def record_success(client_ip) do
    GenServer.cast(__MODULE__, {:success, client_ip})
  end

  def handle_call({:check, ip}, _from, state) do
    {delay, new_state} = calculate_delay(ip, state)
    if delay > 0, do: Process.sleep(delay)
    {:reply, :ok, new_state}
  end

  def handle_cast({:failure, ip}, state) do
    entry = Map.get(state, ip, %{failures: 0, last_failure: 0})
    now = System.system_time(:second)
    new_entry = %{failures: entry.failures + 1, last_failure: now}
    {:noreply, Map.put(state, ip, new_entry)}
  end

  def handle_cast({:success, ip}, state) do
    {:noreply, Map.delete(state, ip)}
  end

  defp calculate_delay(ip, state) do
    case Map.get(state, ip) do
      nil -> {0, state}
      %{failures: f, last_failure: t} ->
        now = System.system_time(:second)
        if now - t > @window_seconds do
          {0, Map.delete(state, ip)}
        else
          delay = min(@initial_delay_ms * trunc(:math.pow(@delay_multiplier, f)), @max_delay_ms)
          {delay, state}
        end
    end
  end
end

defmodule CryptoAuth.Plug do
  @moduledoc """
  Plug that authenticates requests using HMAC tokens.
  Integrates rate limiting and token verification.
  """

  import Plug.Conn

  def init(opts), do: opts

  def call(conn, _opts) do
    client_ip = get_client_ip(conn)
    :ok = CryptoAuth.RateLimiter.check_and_delay(client_ip)

    case CryptoAuth.TokenVerifier.verify_request(conn) do
      :ok ->
        CryptoAuth.RateLimiter.record_success(client_ip)
        conn
      {:error, reason} ->
        CryptoAuth.RateLimiter.record_failure(client_ip)
        conn
        |> put_resp_content_type("application/json")
        |> send_resp(401, Jason.encode!(%{error: to_string(reason)}))
        |> halt()
    end
  end

  # Use the trusted transport-layer peer address for rate-limiting identity.
  # The client-controlled x-forwarded-for header must not be trusted here, as
  # it can be spoofed/rotated to bypass the rate limiter. If a trusted reverse
  # proxy is in use, resolve the real client IP via a vetted RemoteIp plug
  # (with a configured trusted-proxy list) before this plug runs, which will
  # have already set conn.remote_ip correctly.
  defp get_client_ip(conn) do
    to_string(:inet.ntoa(conn.remote_ip))
  end
end
